entries.title: Psalms 125:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 The safety of such as trust in God. 4 A prayer for the godly, and against the wicked.

A.M. 3468. B.C. 536. (Title.) A Song. 120:1; 121:1; 122:1; 123:1; 124:1; *titles that trust. 27:1; 25:2,8; 34:22; 62:2,6; 118:8,9; 147:11; 1Ch 5:20; Pr 3:5,6 Jer 17:7,8; Eph 1:12,13; 1Pe 1:21 be as mount. 132:13,14; Isa 12:6; 14:32; 51:8,11,16; 52:1,7,8; Ob 1:21; Mic 4:2 Zec 1:14,17; Re 14:1 but abideth. Mt 16:16-18

entries.title: Psalms 125:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: As the mountains. La 4:12 the Lord. 34:7; De 33:27; Isa 4:5; Zec 2:5; Joh 10:28,29

entries.title: Psalms 125:3
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: the rod. 103:9,14; Pr 22:8; Isa 10:5; 14:5,6; 27:8; 1Co 10:13; Re 2:10 the wicked. Heb. wickedness.
